title: Memory layer scanning (all 7 layers)
description: MemoryScanner scans all 7 memory layers and returns entities.
rfc_reference: RFC-0024 §Definisi Selesai — Memory Scanner scans all 7 memory layers
expected_behavior: MemoryScanner.scan_all returns GraphNode objects from all 7 MemoryLayer values: working, conversation, knowledge, longterm, episodic, session, project.
